scope: Faithful explicit module/ring consequences of credited CT38/39/40 inputs. Actual abelian varieties,tangent spaces,degree,geometric torsion realization,Frobenius characteristic relation and Tate-module/subgroup bridges remain separate written dependencies. statement: theorem unique_projector_decomposition {M : Type} [IntModule M] (p q : M → M) (pl : ∀ a b, p (a+b) = p a+p b) (ql : ∀ a b, q (a+b) = q a+q b) (hs : ∀ a, p a+q a = a) (hpq : ∀ a, p (q a) = 0) (hqp : ∀ a, q (p a) = 0) (x : M) : p x+q x = x ∧ p (p x) = p x ∧ q (q x) = q x ∧ ∀ a b, p a = a → q b = b → a+b = x → a = p x ∧ b = q x
